lines.en: My smile is carved into my face.

lines.zh: 你闻到那股全黑的味道了吗？
lines.en: Do you smell that all-black scent?

lines.zh: 我贴着矿洞的黑，一步步收拢。
lines.en: I hug the mine's darkness, closing in step by step.
My smile is eternal.
I am everywhere in the dark.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我脚下就多一片黑。
lines.en: Each step you retreat, another patch of black spreads under me.
Come closer...
Don't breathe.

lines.zh: 我的脸全黑，只有牙在笑。
lines.en: My face is all black, only my teeth smile.

lines.zh: 没有脚步声，我照样靠近。
lines.en: There are no footsteps, yet I draw near.

lines.zh: 地面被我吸得沙沙作响。
lines.en: The floor hisses as I pull it toward me.

lines.zh: 我踩着你的影子走过来。
lines.en: I walk over your shadow to reach you.

lines.zh: 黑暗里，我的牙一直露着。
lines.en: In the dark, my teeth stay bared.
My laughter will accompany you.

lines.zh: 你数着出口，我数着你的心跳。
lines.en: You count exits; I count your heartbeats.
Don't crouch — crouching won't save you.
You will never find the exit.

lines.zh: 你的体温，我隔着黑也闻得到。
lines.en: I can smell your body heat through the dark.

lines.zh: 我站在你灯照不到的地方。
lines.en: I stand where your lamp cannot reach.
Do not laugh at me.
Waiting is beautiful.
There is no fear in the darkness.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖弯了一下，我看见了。
lines.en: Your knee buckles once; I see it.
My grin splits to both ears.
My prey is moving.
Your movements are slow.
You are locked in my sight.
Your eyes are full of despair.
Make a decision quickly.
You can't escape.
My gaze will guide you.
You cannot hide.
You carry a torch. I hate light.

lines.zh: 别蹲下，那会让你挣脱的。
lines.en: Don't crouch — that's how you slip free.
Your eyes are losing focus.
Screams and vanishes
Cries out and vanishes
Releases a desperate scream
Screams and disappears
Screams away from you
Screams and vanishes
Screams away
Cries out and vanishes
Screams and vanishes
Screams and disappears

lines.zh: 诡异笑容在黑暗中嘲笑你
lines.en: Sneers at you from the shadows

lines.zh: 你晃那点火，我笑得更大。
lines.en: Wave that little flame and my grin widens.
I'll take you beyond loneliness
There's a partner in the dark
Don't let fear stop me

lines.zh: 你手里的光，我先吃掉那一小团。
lines.en: That light in your hand — I will swallow the small patch first.
You can't escape my tentacles
Find my embrace in the darkness
Come close, fall into the void
My smile is eternal in the dark
You are pulled closer by void forces

lines.zh: 你的速度减缓，视野模糊
lines.en: Your speed is reduced, vision blurred
The closer you get, the greater the danger
Tentacles in the void
Dragged into endless darkness
Darkness consumes your mind
Your movements slow down
In the dark, you cannot escape
Your vision fades away
Void power leaves you helpless
Find a mate, share the void
Fall into the endless abyss together

lines.zh: 虚空中的伴侣，永恒相伴
lines.en: Eternal companions in the void

lines.zh: 黑暗中寻找永恒的拥抱
lines.en: Find eternal embrace in the dark
Fall into endless darkness together
Find my shadow in the dark
Both fall into the endless abyss

lines.zh: 永恒的虚无，共同的归宿
lines.en: Eternal void, shared destination

lines.zh: 黑暗中寻找永恒的伴侣
lines.en: Find an eternal mate in the dark
Fall into the void, never to be separated

lines.zh: 发出沙哑的笑声，消失不见。
lines.en: Screams a raspy laugh, then vanishes.

lines.zh: 你感到一阵剧痛，周围开始扭曲。
lines.en: You feel intense pain as the surroundings distort.

lines.zh: 试图抓住你，但你躲开了。
lines.en: Attempts to grab you but you dodge.

lines.zh: 笑声中带着饥饿的渴望。
lines.en: Its laughter is hungry and insatiable.
It suddenly appears when you get close.

lines.zh: 笑声与尖叫交织在一起。
lines.en: Laughter and screams intermingle.
It seems to be searching for food.

lines.zh: 笑声中夹杂着腐烂的气息。
lines.en: Its laughter is laced with decay.
Attempts to draw you into the void.
Laughter echoes in the darkness.

lines.zh: 瞄准目标，笑声更加阴森。
lines.en: It locks on, and its laughter grows more sinister.

lines.zh: 盯着你，脸上带着诡异的笑容。
lines.en: It stares at you with its eerie grin.
It approaches, preparing to grab you.
Its laughter is threatening.
It stares at you, as if pondering.
It seems quite interested in you.
Its laughter grows louder.
It locks in, ready to act.
Its laughter is tinged with excitement.
Its laughter reveals malice.
My mouth opens; the scream is coming.
My smile pins you in place.
The slower you move, the happier I get.
The light dims; now it's my turn.

lines.zh: 你的火把矮下去，我笑得更开。
lines.en: Your torch sinks lower and my smile widens.
I cannot pronounce your name.

lines.zh: 笑声突然消失，留下寂静。
lines.en: Its laughter abruptly stops, leaving silence.
It stares at you, its grin sinister.
Laughter echoes in the darkness
Its laughter is full of malice.
Its laughter is filled with hunger.
Its laughter carries danger.
Its laughter is laced with decay.
Its laughter carries a threat.

lines.zh: 笑声中带着邪恶的意图。
lines.en: Its laughter has evil intent.

lines.zh: 别闭眼，黑暗里我更清楚。
lines.en: Don't shut your eyes; I see better in the dark.
I drag you over, inch by inch.
Your boots are slipping, aren't they?
Just a little more and I have you.

lines.zh: 你听，尖叫已经在你耳后。
lines.en: Listen — the scream is already behind your ear.

lines.zh: 别看我，看着我的牙就行。
lines.en: Don't look at me; just look at my teeth.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖在发抖，我看见。
lines.en: Your knees are shaking. I can see.
The void is opening under your feet.
I stretch my smile a little wider.

lines.zh: 再近半步，你就归虚空了。
lines.en: Half a step closer and you belong to the void.

lines.zh: 你的影子已经站不起来了。
lines.en: Your shadow can no longer stand upright.

lines.zh: 尖锐笑声尖叫着逼近你！
lines.en: Sharp laugh screams as it approaches!

lines.zh: 它靠近你时会笑得更疯狂！
lines.en: It laughs even more when it gets closer!
Come closer, fall into the abyss!

lines.zh: 笑声中带着死亡的气息！
lines.en: Death in its laugh!
Drawn closer by its laugh!
Its laugh chokes you!
Laughter hides fear!
Laughter drags you to the void!
Coldness in its laughter!
Laughter blinds you!

lines.zh: 我的手穿过黑暗，抓住你。
lines.en: My hand crosses the dark and seizes you.
Nails rake down your back!
Rot creeps out from the wound.

lines.zh: 你被拖向没有底的地方。
lines.en: You're dragged toward a place with no bottom.
My laughter crawls into your ear.
I scream right against your face!
I swallow your light in one gulp.
Got you. Don't bother struggling.
Your skin is starting to blacken.
I press you down into the stone.
Awakens in the darkness!

lines.zh: 只有黑暗才能让它苏醒！
lines.en: Only darkness awakens it!
It awakens in the absence of light!
It waits in the dark!
It awakens in the black!
Its soul awakens in the dark!
It awakens in the shadows!
Its power awakens in the dark!
It awakens in the obscurity!
Its existence awakens in the dark!
Light hits zero; I stand up.
My teeth show first in the crack.
Without a sound, the smiling face takes shape.

lines.zh: 你挖的矿洞太黑了，谢谢。
lines.en: Your mine shaft is dark enough. Thanks.

lines.zh: 我笑着靠近，你蹲下就逃了。
lines.en: I smile and close in — crouch and you slip away.
Fall damage

lines.zh: 水灌进我的笑里，声音闷住了。
lines.en: Water pours into my smile and muffles the sound.

lines.zh: 光炸开，我的笑脸散了一半。
lines.en: Light bursts; half my smile scatters.
Hit by projectile
Hit by magic

lines.zh: 我什么也吸不到，越来越淡。
lines.en: I draw nothing in, and thin away.
Lightning strike

lines.zh: 那张笑脸被虚空收走了。
lines.en: The void took that smiling face back.
